department: Department of Mechanical, Industrial and Systems Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants should apply by February 1; the department lists July 15 for September admission.
deadline.quote: international applicants are expected to apply for fall programs by February 1

app_fee.value: The application file includes a $65 non-refundable fee plus CAS fees.
app_fee.quote: $65 non-refundable application fee, plus Centralized Application System (CAS) fees

gre_general.value: International applicants without a US-based degree must submit GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: International applicants that do not have a degree from a US-based institution also need to submit the GRE score

funding.value: A limited number of assistantships are available each year.
funding.quote: A limited number of teaching and research assistantships are available every year

entry_route.value: Ph.D. applicants should have a master's degree; exceptional bachelor's holders and superior master's candidates are also considered.
entry_route.quote: Ph.D. applicants should have a master’s degree in mechanical engineering, applied mechanics, aerospace engineering, or a related field | Exceptional students with a bachelor’s degree and superior master’s candidates will also be considered

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether an advisor must agree before admission.

notes: Applications go through the Engineering CAS system, so the $65 fee and GRE rule are program overrides.
